source.title: SCHRÖDINGER’S INKUBATOR – EIERLEGENDE WOLLMILCHSAU
source.location: conversation upload; bytes not imported to GitHub
source.verbatim_core: Die gesamte Software Infrastruktur, um jedes beliebige Projekt zu realisieren.
source.note: This is a historical concept sheet, not a proven deployed platform.

projects.role: public digital sovereignty and solutions atlas
people matching, A/N, teams and contributions
reuse of established software capabilities and tests
optional testing of skill orchestration, not prerequisite
optional relational validation and derivations, not generic software label

modules.core: interfaces, event logs, export/import and tests

goal: shared, understandable, portable and maintained software capabilities across different projects
first_benchmark: Compare at least three existing open components for one real use case, run one minimal function, verify export, license, permissions and maintenance obligations
safety: Never describe this as an installed running system without execution evidence.

architecture_hypothesis.statement: Software is increasingly composed from reusable, independently testable, proven core modules
architecture_hypothesis.avoid: Do not conflate API connection, scientific skill or AI capability

closed_source.limitation: No blanket permission for unauthorized copying, protection bypass or near-identical proprietary code reproduction; case-by-case legal review

research_tasks.title: Inventory actually existing open-source modules for one workflow
research_tasks.done: three products verified; licenses and export tests captured

research_tasks.title: Execute one real cross-program interface test
research_tasks.done: identical typed inputs and outputs plus errors and round-trip checked

research_tasks.title: Verify interoperability at technical semantic organizational legal layers
research_tasks.done: all four layers documented including negative cases

research_tasks.title: Compare modular versus monolithic implementation
research_tasks.done: same use case; effort, correctness, resources and maintenance compared

research_tasks.title: Document official API and interoperability legal boundary of one proprietary system
research_tasks.done: documented source, standard and lawful interface, no unauthorized copied code

publication_policy.deliverable: digital research annexes and publishable web/documents
publication_policy.historical_pdf_status: only original one-page user PDF, not a printed book
publication_policy.book_style: reader-friendly without internal task IDs; technical work in GitHub
